Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for SaaS multi-tenant application

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues: [development, staging, production]
    Description: Environment name for tagging and naming

  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: saas-app
    Description: Application name used for resource naming
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$'

  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC where the Aurora cluster will be deployed

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: Private subnet IDs (minimum 2 in different AZs) for the DB subnet group

  AllowedSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id>
    Description: Security group IDs allowed to connect to the database (application tier)

  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: saasapp
    Description: Initial database name
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,62}$'

  MasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: dbadmin
    Description: Master database username
    NoEcho: true
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,62}$'

  EngineVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '15.4'
    Description: Aurora PostgreSQL engine version

  MinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.5
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Minimum Aurora Serverless v2 capacity (ACUs)

  MaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 16
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Maximum Aurora Serverless v2 capacity (ACUs)

  BackupRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 35
    Description: Backup retention period in days

  PreferredBackupWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: '03:00-04:00'
    Description: Preferred daily backup window (UTC)

  PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: 'sun:04:30-sun:05:30'
    Description: Preferred weekly maintenance window (UTC)

  DeletionProtection:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable deletion protection

  EnablePerformanceInsights:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

  CreateReadReplica:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Whether to create a read replica instance

Conditions:
  IsProduction: !Equals [!Ref EnvironmentName, production]
  EnablePI: !Equals [!Ref EnablePerformanceInsights, 'true']
  CreateReader: !Equals [!Ref CreateReadReplica, 'true']

Resources:

  DatabaseKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName} Aurora cluster encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowRDSService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-aurora-kms'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DatabaseKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-aurora'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DatabaseKMSKey

  DatabaseMasterSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ApplicationName}/${EnvironmentName}/aurora/master-credentials'
      Description: !Sub 'Master credentials for ${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName} Aurora cluster'
      KmsKeyId: !Ref DatabaseKMSKey
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: !Sub '{"username": "${MasterUsername}"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\$`'":;{}[]()'
        ExcludePunctuation: false
        IncludeSpace: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
